messages:
alex: heads-up — planning a cutover for argo-13b (quant-v2) into the model catalog tonight 23:00 UTC. Change window 23:00–01:00 UTC. Need fallback ordering, pinlist, rollback thresholds. Acks?

maria: ack. prefer canary 5% in us-east first.

sebastian: +1 canary. propose fallback ordering: argo-13b-quantv2 -> argo-13b-quantv1 -> titan-slim. TTL for fallback 10m.

jin: suggest rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >40% for 5m OR error-rate delta >1% for 5m. also flag token-cost regression >12%.

lia: release notes drafted here: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/argo-quant-v2 (internal). include note about quant artifacts & eval set.

ops: recommend adding canary metrics to watch: gen_time_p95_us-east, mem_saturation, kv_cache_hit_ratio. ops will monitor dashboards and set alerts.

alex: @deploybot schedule canary at 23:00 UTC, 5% us-east. pin model for canary -> model:argo-13b@v3-quant (pinlist argo-quant-pin-v1).

deploybot: Scheduled 'catalog-enable argo-13b@v3-quant' — canary 5% us-east at 2025-11-05T23:00:00Z. Canary ID: cb-1777777000. To run now: /deploybot run cb-1777777000

maria: running preflight checks now -> config ok, weight routing ready.

alex: starting canary -> /deploybot run cb-1777777000

deploybot: ✅ Canary started. Traffic routed 5% to argo-13b@v3-quant in us-east. Telemetry hooks attached. Watch p95/p50/err and cost.

sebastian: seeing p95 jump to 420ms in us-east (baseline ~220ms).

ops: observed error rate up 1.6% above baseline for last 3m, p95 up ~90%. token-cost change negligible.

alex: rolling decision call — per the agreed triggers (p95 >40% for 5m OR error delta >1% for 5m) ops recommends rollback.

ops: initiating rollback now.

deploybot: Rollback executed — traffic shifted back to argo-13b@v2-quant (previous stable). Pin restored to argo-13b@v2-quant. Canary cb-1777777000 closed. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks team. delaying global cutover. filing postmortem and scheduling follow-up to investigate perf regression (likely kernel selection / quant path).

lia: will update release notes and notify customers on hold.
